column1: # Added by the aterm project in 2026 to its copy of winit 0.30.13
# The shadow sctk-adwaita 0.10.1 drew outside a client-decorated window
# before LW.5 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 Bartłomiej Maryńczak), recorded
# L-HEADER-LW7, lw5-button-layout-shadow) from the crate's own shadow.rs.
# plane: one border part's buffer as Shadow::draw paints it (premultiplied
# RGBA bytes, tiny-skia's layout; the visible border is drawn after it, in
# lib.rs), for a window of `window` logical px whose top and bottom parts
# span the window and both borders and whose sides span its height:
# the buffer's size in px, its alpha summed, and an FNV-1a 64 of its bytes.
